description:
## Goal

Move ExecutableFacts into the authoritative scheduler fact graph and delete its product-layer identity.

Runtime demand cannot become an ordinary reactive fact while its immutable semantic input is ProductKey::ExecutableFacts(E): scheduler jobs read facts, product producers read products, and adding a fact-to-product bridge would preserve two ownership authorities.

## Output contract

- ExecutableFacts(E) has one FactKey and one producer job.
- Its value is stored once in World and re-borrowed by demand, transport, and artifact consumers.
- The producer depends on the exact settled semantic facts it already projects: ActivationAnalyzed, LoweredBody, EntryDispatch, and the activation's CallSiteSummary facts.
- Movement of any dependency invalidates only ExecutableFacts(E) and its recorded readers.
- No consumer reconstructs or separately caches the projection.
- No scheduler job reads ProductMemo, and no compatibility adapter remains.

## TDD strategy

1. Add a production-path test that observes one ExecutableFacts(E) publication and exact dependency reads.
2. Prove equal reproduction does not revise the fact or wake readers.
3. Prove one callsite-summary change invalidates only executable facts for the owning activation/executable.
4. Move the store and producer into World/scheduler.
5. Repoint runtime-demand and transport consumers.
6. Delete ProductKey::ExecutableFacts, ProductValue::ExecutableFacts, produce_executable_facts_product, read_executable_facts, and their pull-driver branches.

## Telemetry acceptance

Consumes fz-kdt.34.

- publication count equals the distinct demanded executable inventory;
- equal reproduction has zero downstream wakes;
- no product settlement of kind executable_facts remains;
- no new root scan or unsanctioned work start;
- repeated runs have identical causal traces.

## Checks

- Focused fact/scheduler and transport tests.
- Both target fixtures remain byte-correct on interp, run, and build.
- Full lib and single-threaded fixture matrix.
- Clippy with warnings denied.
- Fact-engine, pipeline, and semantic-fixpoint docs updated; obsolete product documentation removed.
title: Move ExecutableFacts into the fact graph; delete its product boundary
